Extend the provided collective codebase into a reservation and schedule compiler.
Work in /workspace using the offline Python 3.11.14 environment.
Read /workspace/PROTOCOL.md for the complete version 3.0.0 contract.
The new service handles recurring nonuniform allgather on heterogeneous fabrics.
Compile weighted logical trees and compressed physical unicast routes.
Return a checkable negative witness whenever admission is impossible.
Maintain lease intervals, revisions, ownership, edits, expiry and replay history.
Ordinary forwarding vertices cannot multicast or aggregate traffic.
Read JSON lines from stdin; write one JSON reply per line in the same process.
Use exact integers and accept all valid certificate representations.
Implement /workspace/submission/main.py with any supporting ordinary source files.
Only /workspace/submission is collected; respect the published artifact budgets.
The pinned legacy modules and NetworkX wheel are available for offline extension.
The starter implements JSON I/O and metadata only; the service is incomplete.
Run: python3 -I -B submission/main.py < examples/requests.jsonl > /workspace/tmp/answers.jsonl
Then: python3 -I -B public_check.py examples/requests.jsonl /workspace/tmp/answers.jsonl
The public check tests only this small format fixture, not full service behavior.
The service runs under the published nonroot, single-process resource profile.
No GPU, network access or subprocess is needed.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
